newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP council says rate rise possible by autumn.
newsitem.headline: LDP council says rate rise possible by autumn.

text.p: A senior official of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party's (LDP) Policy Research Council said on Friday that he sees a chance of a credit tightening in Japan by early autumn, given improving economic fundamentals.
Koji Omi, deputy chairman of the LDP council, told Reuters: "There is a chance of an interest rate increase by early autumn as economic fundamentals are getting better."
Interest rates in Japan have been exceptionally low by historical standards, he added.
Bad loan problems at Japanese banks have passed their peak, and thus Japanese authorities should give due consideration to people such as as pensioners who depend on interest rate income, he added.
